name: Tailnet
description: Joins the dev container to your tailnet at container start, with Tailscale SSH, a tag and the hostname <prefix>-<folder>-dev. Configures the Tailscale Feature; it does not install Tailscale.

hostnamePrefix.description: Prefix of the hostname. Empty means the container variable HOSTNAME_PREFIX. If that is also empty, the hostname is <folder>-dev. Letters, digits and hyphens only.

tags.description: Comma-separated Tailscale tags to advertise, each like tag:devcontainer. The tailnet policy must let the key own them.

authKeyVar.description: Name of the container environment variable that holds the auth key at container start. The key is never stored in the image.

ssh.description: Turn Tailscale SSH on. Tested with the Tailscale Feature 1.0.8 and Tailscale 1.104.7.
